findings.fact: ParentView returns a cached view only while it remains in the application registered-view list; stale cached links issue source error reporting and are cleared to null.

ViewModified can schedule active-view refresh first using IsWindow and SetTimer(ID10,200ms,null), guarded by a pending flag. Non-page views call RhSynchronizeViews; a false reentrant result returns before later dirty/properties effects.

Document virtual slot+0xd8 is invoked with1 only when application setting+0xf8 is enabled. Document properties owner+0xd40 is refreshed only for null changed view or its selected view, then flagged+0x1458.

RhSynchronizeViews returns false when its global guard already equals1. Otherwise disabled settings/null/maximized/perspective/missing-document/invalid-scale paths return true without synchronization. Accepted paths snapshot eligible non-page views and set the guard before updating other eligible parallel views.

Synchronization computes source/destination scale ratio, adjusts target/camera in the destination camera plane, scales four lateral frustum bounds while retaining near/far, applies SetTarget and SetVP, sets view bytes at+0x618 and requests RedrawViewHelper. It clears the guard on normal completion; no exception-cleanup equivalence is inferred.

The scale helper obtains client size from GetClientRect and requires positive min(width,height); it uses the minimum absolute lateral frustum bound, divides by near for perspective, multiplies by mirror-target/camera distance for perspective or source constant1 otherwise, then divides by min client size. It ignores GetFrustum success and calls TargetPoint before reading mirror values; invalid uninitialized-output behavior is not reconstructed.

Redraw hint is unsigned min(current,incoming), with additional source debug-counter behavior for hint3. Properties refresh/population has real document/command/view/plane dependencies rather than a simple counter.

limits: Static original source only; original application never executes
MFC timer/window scheduling, virtual document ownership, properties population and synchronization still require concrete portable implementations
No source data-race/uninitialized-output/exception-cleanup or opaque-field meaning is invented
Complete SetView/Pop/document/GDI/PC/physical/full application acceptance remains open
